meta.name: theme-factory
meta.description: Toolkit for styling artifacts with a theme. These artifacts can be slides, docs, reportings, HTML landing pages, etc. There are 10 pre-set themes with colors/fonts that you can apply to any artifact that has been creating, or can generate a new theme on-the-fly.

copy.tagline: 为幻灯片、文档等作品快速套用或生成主题样式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要为演示文稿或文档统一配色和字体风格
copy.tagline_en: Quickly apply or generate themes for slides, docs, and more
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to unify colors and fonts across presentations or documents

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以给幻灯片、文档、报告等作品套用预设的 10 种主题（含配色和字体），也能根据你的描述现场生成新主题并应用。
howto.when: 当你要求美化幻灯片、文档等作品，或者提到“主题”、“配色”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 给我展示一下所有可用的主题。
say.note: Claude 会列出 10 种预设主题供你选择。

say.text: 把“海洋深处”主题应用到这份幻灯片上。
say.note: Claude 会读取主题规格并统一应用配色和字体。

say.text: 帮我创建一个以“星空”为主题的新风格。
say.note: Claude 会生成新主题并展示给你确认。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can apply one of 10 preset themes (colors and fonts) to artifacts like slides, docs, or reports, or generate a custom theme on the fly based on your description.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to beautify slides, docs, etc., or mention keywords like "theme" or "color scheme".

say_en.note: Claude will list the 10 preset themes for you to choose.

say_en.text: Apply the "Ocean Depths" theme to this slide deck.
say_en.note: Claude will read the theme specs and apply colors and fonts consistently.

say_en.text: Create a new theme inspired by "starry sky".
say_en.note: Claude will generate a custom theme and show it for your review.
